comparison.objective: Press a button through an aperture, versus adjust, lock, and cycle-test an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained linear reach and button actuation versus tool insertion, bimanual stabilization, controlled rotation, and force-limited locking; candidate button pressing is only a subordinate cycle-control action.
comparison.success_condition: Button actuation is title-implied, with no body/specs, aperture tolerance, or activation rubric. Candidate success depends on two safe dynamic stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Sharing button actuation does not create overlap because the candidate's tested outcome is damper commissioning, not isolated button access.
